newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan interbank rate ends slightly higher.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan interbank rate ends slightly higher.

text.p: Taiwan's interbank rate closed slightly higher on Monday, reflecting strong demand for liquidity ahead of the Chinese lunar new year on February 7, dealers said.
The overnight interbank rate ended at 5.874 percent against Saturday's 5.851 close, with commercial paper at 5.85-5.90 percent against 5.75-5.90.
Dealers expected the rates to stabilise at their current levels before the lunar new year due to the central bank's recent injections of fund to check further rises.
In the bond market, the 10-year 86/4 bond yield was at 6.1425 percent against 6.1350.
